1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256391|209fae46.name: Elaine Compton
256391|209fae46.text:
Not every order goes according to plan. While we strive to ensure that each delivery arrives intact and efficiently, a recent rise of beasts, bandits, and even Horde attacks, unfortunately cause some unavoidable loss of goods.

Should you find any lost shipments and are feeling particularly helpful, you can take a look over the label and identify its expected contents. It is not your responsibility to deal with our shortcomings of course, but if you completed the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind.

Ms. Baker near the crates will handle your compensation, and we will take care of the logistics from there.

256391|3090047f.name: Elaine Compton
256391|3090047f.text:
Oh goodness, you snuck up on me! Glad to see you, $N, the Azeroth Commerce Authority is always in need of new contractors.

If you are the sort to enjoy a stroll through the forest gathering useful materials or possess the skills to craft something from scratch, well, you have found yourself right at home!

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256729|06bc17cb.name: Nina Surefire
256729|06bc17cb.text:
I know what you're thinking, but don't worry, we keep our cooking and alchemy ingredients separate!

How can I help you?

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256733|8265ab1b.name: Fritz Fizzle
256733|8265ab1b.text: Pleased to meet you! If you like to tinker, you have come to the right place!

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

107-complete.name: William Pestle
107-complete.text:
My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe.  I remember being young and in love, once.

There must be something I can do to help them!  Let me think...
107-complete.title: Note to William

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

112-accept.name: William Pestle
112-accept.text:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
112-accept.title: Collecting Kelp

123-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
123-progress.text:
What?!?  We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!

Let me see that note you have...
123-progress.title: The Collector

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

184-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-progress.text:
You have the deed to my farm??  That's good news!  Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!

Please, let me have it.  We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
184-progress.title: Furlbrow's Deed

1861-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
1861-progress.text: Do you have the sample, $N?  The flow of magic in Stormwind and Elwynn has been altered, and I must know if it is seeping into the water.
1861-progress.title: Mirror Lake

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79093-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79093-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79093-complete.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79093-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79093-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79093-progress.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

86667-accept.name: Grenhild Darktalon
86667-accept.text:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667-accept.title: Snowbound

86667-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
86667-complete.text:
This jar is for me?

Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!

A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.

Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
86667-complete.title: Snowbound

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

91751-accept.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-accept.text: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751-accept.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

92742-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92742-accept.text:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742-accept.title: Testing the Wells

92744-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-accept.text:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744-accept.title: Murloc Gills

92909-accept.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-accept.text:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

97286-complete.name: Garion Wendell
97286-complete.text: Your actions show you are one who respects knowledge. The library is open for use in your studies.
97286-complete.title: Research Access

99127-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99127-accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight, go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127-accept.title: A Net Disaster

99127-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99127-complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127-complete.title: A Net Disaster

99128-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99128-accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128-accept.title: Slimy Menace

99143-accept.name: Lee Brown
99143-accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143-accept.title: Bottles and Baubles

99159-accept.name: Father Gavin
99159-accept.text:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159-accept.title: Finding Warmth
